limitations: No live Neo4j or Postgres in this environment. Org-scoping, RBAC allow/deny/path_prefix predicates, single-hop prerequisite traversal, and PART_OF-only grouping are proven against the exported Cypher text plus the TypeScript mapper exercised with real row fixtures, not against a running database — the same established convention as every existing query in graph-query/index.ts. Residual risk: a Cypher semantic error the text assertions cannot see.

MCPT-09/10/11 (API-key generation/storage, issuance scope, rotation/expiry/revocation) are UNVERIFIED: mcpKeyService.ts and the permissions/DB schema are unmodified by this diff, and no live Postgres is available to dynamically exercise rotation/revocation in this environment.

The MCP SDK's server-side Protocol implementation does not enforce that 'initialize' precede 'tools/call' (confirmed in vendored @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0 source and reproduced dynamically against both get_ready_tickets and a sibling tool identically). This is 100% shared, vendored, pre-existing behavior untouched by this diff; authentication and RBAC are still fully enforced regardless (verified: a request without a valid bearer token is still rejected 401 even when initialize is skipped). Recorded as a limitation/informational note, not a FAIL, since no authorization boundary is bypassed.
